trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَابِنْتَ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَابِنْتَ نَبِیِّ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَابِنْتَ مُحَمَّدِ
الْمُصْطَفٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَابِنْتَ وَلِیِّ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَابِنْتَ عَلِیِّ

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA RASOOLILLAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA NABIYYILLAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA MUHAMMADENIL MUSTAFA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA VALIYYILLAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA A’LIYYENIL MURTAZA SAYYEDIL AWSEYAAE WASSIDDEEQEENA.

trans.en: Salam on you, O daughter of Rasoolullah! Salam on you, O daughter of Nabiyullah! Salam on you, O daughter of Muhammad Mustafa! Salam on you, O daughter of the leader of the Prophets and Messengers! Salam on you, O daughter of the friend (Vali) of Allah! Salam on you, O daughter of the Ali-e-Murtaza, who is the leader of the Regents and True ones!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَا بِنْتَ فَاطِمَۃَ الزَّہْرَائِ سَیِّدَۃِ نِسَائِ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَا اُخْتَ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَیْنِ سَیِّدَیْ شَبَابِ اَہْلِ الْجَنَّۃِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا السَّیِّدَۃُ الزَّکِیَّۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الدَّاعِیَۃُ الْخَفِیِّۃُ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA BINTA FATEMATUZ ZAHRAE SAYYEDATE NESAAIL AALAMEENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA UKHTAL HASANE WAL HUSAYNE SAYYEDAY SHABAABE AHLIL JANNATE AJMAE’ENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAS SAYYEDATUZ ZAKIYYATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAD DAAE’YATUL KHAFIYYATO.

trans.en: Salam on you, O daughter of Fatemah Zahra, who is the leader of the women of all the worlds! Salam on you, O sister of Hazrat Imam Hasan and Hazrat Imam Husain who are the leaders of all the youths of Heaven! Salam on you, O Sayyada’e Tahera (pure)! Salam on you, O invitor towards truth on all occasions! Salam on you, O one who is always afraid of Allah, O pure one!

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا التَّقِیَّۃُ النَّقِیَّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الرَّاضِیَۃُ الْمَرْضِیَّۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الْعَالِمَۃُ الْغَیْرُ الْمُعَلَّمَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الْفَہِیْمَۃُ الْغَیْرُ الْمُفَہَّمَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الْمَظْلُوْمَۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا مَہْمُوْمَۃُ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAT TAQIYYATUN NAQIYYATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAR RAAZEYATUL MARZIYYATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL A’ALEMATUL GHAIRUL MOA’LLAMATE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL FAHIMATUL GHAIRUL MOFAHHAMATE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL MAZLOOMATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL MAHMOOMATO.

trans.en: Salam on you, O one who is content with Allah and with whom Allah is content! Salam on you, O one who is learned without being taught by anyone! Salam on you, O one who understands everything, without explanation from anyone! Salam on you, O one who was tormented!

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الْمَغْمُوْمَۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الصِّدِّیْقَۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الْمَکْرُوْبَۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتُہَا الْمَاسُوْرَۃُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ اَیَّتَہَا الصَّاحِبَۃُ الْمُصِیْبَۃِ الْعُظْمٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکِ یَا زَیْنَبُ الْکُبْرٰی وَرَحْمَۃُ اللہِ وَبَرَکَاتُہٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL MAGHMOOMATO AS SALAAMMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAS SIDDEEQATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL MAKROOBATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAL MA’SOORATO ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE AYYATOHAS SAAHEBATUL MOSIBATIL U’ZMAA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKE YAA ZAINABUL KUBRA WA RAHMATULLAAHE WA BARAKAATOH.

trans.en: Salam on you, O one who continued to bear unhappiness! Salam on you, O one whose life was passed in sadness! Salam on you, O one who always spoke the truth! Salam on you, O one who bore hardships! Salam on you, O one who was always surrounded by tribulations! Salam on you, O one who always shouldered big hardships! Salam on you, O Zainab-e-Kubra and Allah’s blessings and bounties be on you!

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: Then recite 2 rakats Namaz-e-Ziyarat like Fajr namaz.
desc.rurdu: Phir 2 rakat Namaz-e-Ziyarat, Fajr namaz ki tarah padhe.
desc.urdu: پھر ۲ رکعت نماز زیارت (نماز فجر کی طرح) پڑھے۔
